citations.assessment: Idi bar Gershom gives the ruling in Rav Adda bar Ahavah’s name. The digital title Rav differs from Heilprin’s abbreviation resolved in the English as Rabbi.
The witness reads bar Perata and Rabbi Biryayim and names the elder Rabbi Yaakov.
The matching digital section is 10:6:8, which reads Adda bar Gershon and gives the elder in Rabbi’s name. It preserves a compressed transmission list.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Rav Shemen reports in the name of Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershem in this version, with an extra Idi compared with Heilprin’s running name.
